Fixed. The hydration style-mismatch check was comparing the server-rendered CSS var name (which is escaped, e.g. `--foo\.bar`) against the unescaped client key (`--foo.bar`), causing false-positive "Hydration style mismatch" warnings when `v-bind()` in CSS produced var names containing symbols — including the child-component-with-style-bindings scenario from the issue.

Changes (matching upstream PR vuejs/core#11739):
- `packages/shared/src/escapeHtml.ts` — moved `getEscapedCssVarName`/`cssVarNameEscapeSymbolsRE` here (from `compiler-sfc`) so runtime can use it
- `packages/compiler-sfc/src/script/utils.ts` — removed the moved helper
- `packages/compiler-sfc/src/style/cssVars.ts` — import from `@vue/shared`
- `packages/runtime-core/src/hydration.ts:918` — `resolveCssVars` now applies `getEscapedCssVarName(key, false)` when building the expected style map, so escaped var names in the server HTML match

Verified: hydration.spec.ts (including the previously failing `escape css var name`), compiler-sfc, compiler-ssr, server-renderer, shared, and full runtime-core suites all pass; typecheck and eslint clean. No test files modified.
